issues.text: Recommendation to ORCH: push ONE more temporary snapshot, a new branch such as ci/m1-status-2 (no reuse of ci/m1-status-1, no force), whose tree is origin/main e0a425b plus ONLY the two new test files app/test/unit/texts.test.js and app/test/e2e/landing.test.js (the product files of REQ-113 stay at the base). Expected red there: unit TX-4, TX-9, TX-10 (unit step ends with # fail 3 of 122; because npm run check is a && chain the int step does not run in that job, which is expected); e2e LD-3, LD-6, LD-9 (# fail 3 of 15; the other 12 stay green; pg and docker jobs stay green). That gives the 'red on the base' proof in Linux Chrome with the real messages, and costs one e2e job of roughly 8 to 9 minutes. Read the messages of the three red e2e tests, not only their names: a test red by a timeout (180, 480 or 300 s) or an import error instead of the intended assertion would be a false proof. A re-run of the green snapshot proves nothing new. The mutant series stays optional.

Scope of the PASS: the green record is for app/ of HEAD plus main's outside tree. The check on the real release commit must still be seen on GitHub, and RELEASE-VALIDATOR runs its own command (quality-bar Q2); this PASS does not carry over to step 9.
